external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: Customers who browse and place orders through the mobile app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application used by customers to browse and order.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: API used by the mobile app; it maintains customer data and hands orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication is unknown: "Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication".

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: Stock and inventory system that processes orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: Gateway that faxes dispatch confirmations to customers.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
processes.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

processes.name: catalogue macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: Database containing customer names, addresses, and payment card data.
data_stores.source_excerpt: name, address, and the card they paid with
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: Flat file containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: Spreadsheet containing the marketing catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: The mobile app talks to the web API for browsing and ordering.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: hand order
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: Catalogue macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: Office network location where the marketing laptop hosting the spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office

assumptions.assumption: The user database is confidential because it contains customer names, addresses, and payment card data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the user database contains "name, address, and the card they paid with".

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains only delivery addresses.
